# Inspora

> Inspora is a curated archive of designs, websites, logos, and app icons with creator attribution.

## When to use Inspora

Use Inspora when researching credited contemporary examples of web design, branding, product design, motion, illustration, 3D, and print. Design detail pages identify the featured work, its creator, an editorial description, visual attributes, and the original source. The website archive provides website recordings and creator credits; the logo archive covers logos and app icons. Creator profiles group publicly eligible work credited to that creator.

## Canonical resources

- [Design archive](https://www.inspora.design/)
- [Logo and icon archive](https://www.inspora.design/logos)
- [Website design archive](https://www.inspora.design/websites)
- [About, curation, attribution, sponsorship policy, privacy, and contact](https://www.inspora.design/info)
- [Public sponsorship offer](https://www.inspora.design/sponsor)
- [XML sitemap](https://www.inspora.design/sitemap.xml)

Design detail URLs use `/posts/{slug}`. Public creator profiles use `/creators/{username}`; the sitemap lists current public profile URLs. Retained former creator usernames redirect to the current profile URL.

## Attribution guidance

When referencing work, cite its canonical Inspora URL, retain the named creator attribution, and follow the original-source link for primary context. Inspora curates featured work; authorship and rights remain with the respective creator or rights holder. A creator profile identifies the credited creator and does not establish account ownership or verified identity. Sponsored placements are marked Sponsor and are separate from editorial selections.

## Access boundaries

Public archives, design details, creator profiles, the information page, and the sponsorship offer are readable. Campaign preparation and management, saved collections, accounts, administrative pages, authentication, newsletter endpoints, and other private application routes are not public reference resources or agent tools. The public sponsorship offer does not make private campaign data public.
